question: Simplify the following expression. (6 + 6 of 5 ÷ 5) ÷ 6 of 5 + (24 ÷ 2 of 3 - 6 of 5 + 4)
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify the following expression:

(6 + 6 of 5 ÷ 5) ÷ 6 of 5 + (24 ÷ 2 of 3 - 6 of 5 + 4)

**Formula Used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e., powers and roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication (left-to-right), Addition and Subtraction (left-to-right).

**Calculation:**

(6 + 6 of 5 ÷ 5) ÷ 6 of 5 + (24 ÷ 2 of 3 - 6 of 5 + 4

⇒ (6 + 30 ÷ 5) ÷ 6 of 5 + (24 ÷ 6 - 30 + 4)

⇒ (6 + 6) ÷ 6 of 5 + (4 - 30 + 4)

⇒ 12 ÷ 6 of 5 + (-22)

⇒ 12 ÷ 30 + (-22)

⇒ 2/5 + (-22)

⇒ (2-110)/5

⇒ (-108)/5 = - 21(3)/(5)

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
